title: Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) Non-Covered Share Points for Insured Payoffs
content:
**Rule.** On an insured Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) account paid off in full, the non-covered share is the account's non-covered-service liability postings as a percent of all its liability postings. A share of at least 50 percent adds 2 percentage points to the insured payoff discount percent; a share of at least 20 percent but below 50 percent adds 1 percentage point; a smaller share, or no liability posting, adds none.

## Input, judgement, output

| Non-covered-service postings | All liability postings | Share | Percentage points added |
|---|---|---|---|
| 600.00 | 1200.00 | 50 percent | 2 |
| 300.00 | 1200.00 | 25 percent | 1 |
| 240.00 | 1200.00 | 20 percent | 1 |
| 200.00 | 1200.00 | about 16.7 percent | none |
| none | none | no liability posting | none |

(All figures in the table are hypothetical.)

Both totals are taken from the account's liability postings as posted: the non-covered-service postings are measured against the total of every liability posting of any source.
